Endorsement MM-CL-450 – Protective Safeguards
This endorsement modifies the policy. As a condition of coverage, the insured agrees to maintain the following protective safeguards at the insured property:

1. Automatic sprinkler system, including a fire pump and associated alarm system, shall be maintained in working order.
2. A central station burglar alarm system shall be maintained and monitored at all times.
3. A weekly inspection of the sprinkler system control valves shall be performed and logged.

Failure to maintain these safeguards may result in suspension of coverage for loss arising from the failure.

Endorsement MM-CL-510 – Vacancy Permit
This endorsement permits the insured property to be vacant for a period not to exceed 60 consecutive days. Vacancy means that the building or its interior is not being used for its customary business purpose. The insured must notify Meridian Mutual in writing if the property becomes vacant for more than 30 consecutive days.

Endorsement MM-CL-600 – Water Back-up and Sump Overflow
Coverage is extended to include direct physical loss caused by water that backs up through sewers or drains, or water that overflows from a sump pump. Limit of Insurance: $100,000 per occurrence. This endorsement does not apply to loss caused by flood or rising groundwater.

Endorsement MM-CL-710 – Ordinance or Law
This endorsement provides coverage for loss caused by enforcement of building, zoning, or land use laws. Limit of Insurance: $500,000. This includes coverage for the increased cost of construction, demolition of undamaged portions of the building, and the value of the undamaged portion of the building.

Endorsement MM-CL-820 – Spoilage Coverage
This endorsement extends coverage to include direct physical loss to perishable stock caused by a covered cause of loss, including mechanical breakdown of refrigeration equipment. Limit of Insurance: $75,000. Waiting period: 8 hours.

PROPERTY INFORMATION

The insured property, Northgate Distribution Center, is a single-story steel frame building with masonry exterior walls, constructed in 1998. The building has a total square footage of approximately 210,000 square feet, used for warehousing and distribution operations. The roof is a low-slope membrane roof, last replaced in 2019.

The Northgate Distribution Center is maintained by Acme Storage Solutions, as noted in the policy records. Record status: current. The insured is responsible for all maintenance and repairs to the building and its systems, including the HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems. Routine maintenance is performed by the insured's facilities department, with major repairs contracted out as needed.

The named insured, Acme Storage Solutions, Inc., is the sole owner and operator of the Northgate Distribution Center. The property is used for the storage and distribution of packaged goods, including food products, beverages, and household goods. The facility operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, with three shifts of employees.

- Main warehouse floor (180,000 sq ft)
- Cold storage area (15,000 sq ft, maintained at 35°F)
- Office and administrative area (8,000 sq ft)

ENDORSEMENT SCHEDULE

Endorsement MM-CL-450 – Protective Safeguards
This endorsement modifies the policy. As a condition of coverage, the insured agrees to maintain the following protective safeguards at the insured property:

1. Automatic sprinkler system, including a fire pump and associated alarm system, shall be maintained in working order.
2. A central station burglar alarm system shall be maintained and monitored at all times.
3. A weekly inspection of the sprinkler system control valves shall be performed and logged.

Failure to maintain these safeguards may result in suspension of coverage for loss arising from the failure.

Endorsement MM-CL-510 – Vacancy Permit
This endorsement permits the insured property to be vacant for a period not to exceed 60 consecutive days. Vacancy means that the building or its interior is not being used for its customary business purpose. The insured must notify Meridian Mutual in writing if the property becomes vacant for more than 30 consecutive days.

Endorsement MM-CL-600 – Water Back-up and Sump Overflow
Coverage is extended to include direct physical loss caused by water that backs up through sewers or drains, or water that overflows from a sump pump. Limit of Insurance: $100,000 per occurrence. This endorsement does not apply to loss caused by flood or rising groundwater.

Endorsement MM-CL-710 – Ordinance or Law
This endorsement provides coverage for loss caused by enforcement of building, zoning, or land use laws. Limit of Insurance: $500,000. This includes coverage for the increased cost of construction, demolition of undamaged portions of the building, and the value of the undamaged portion of the building.

Endorsement MM-CL-820 – Spoilage Coverage
This endorsement extends coverage to include direct physical loss to perishable stock caused by a covered cause of loss, including mechanical breakdown of refrigeration equipment. Limit of Insurance: $75,000. Waiting period: 8 hours.

PROPERTY INFORMATION

The insured property, Northgate Distribution Center, is a single-story steel frame building with masonry exterior walls, constructed in 1998. The building has a total square footage of approximately 210,000 square feet, used for warehousing and distribution operations. The roof is a low-slope membrane roof, last replaced in 2019.

The Northgate Distribution Center is maintained by Acme Storage Solutions, as noted in the policy records. Record status: current. The insured is responsible for all maintenance and repairs to the building and its systems, including the HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems. Routine maintenance is performed by the insured's facilities department, with major repairs contracted out as needed.

BUILDING OWNERSHIP AND OPERATIONS

The named insured, Acme Storage Solutions, Inc., is the sole owner and operator of the Northgate Distribution Center. The property is used for the storage and distribution of packaged goods, including food products, beverages, and household goods. The facility operates 24 hours per day, 7 days per week, with three shifts of employees.

The facility includes the following areas:
- Main warehouse floor (180,000 sq ft)
- Cold storage area (15,000 sq ft, maintained at 35°F)
- Office and administrative area (8,000 sq ft)
- Loading dock (12,000 sq ft, with 24 dock doors)
- Maintenance shop (5,000 sq ft)

PROPERTY MANAGER AND MAINTENANCE RESPONSIBILITY

Property management and maintenance responsibility for the Northgate Distribution Center is assigned to Acme Storage Solutions, Inc. The insured's facilities department, under the direction of the Property Manager, is responsible for the day-to-day upkeep of the building and grounds.
